Ken Poston is the Founder/Director of the L.A. Jazz Institute, and Director of Concert Productions at KKJZ Radio in Los Angeles. His devotion to and enthusiasm for the art form is inspiring.
Ken was interviewed via Zoom on June 4, 2024 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
